Combate e Pets podem ler passivamente os: Combat and Pets can passively read data received by the game connection using Npcap. Automatic reading waits for the game and can be disabled in Combat settings and the Pets tab. Both modules share one connection. Raw packets are not recorded or uploaded. The scoreboard displays observed damage and identifies partial data.
